content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for APEDA Associate (Legal) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the APEDA Associate (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09 September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Associate (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Associate (Legal) position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 90,000 to Rs. 1,20,000.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) degree with at least 2 years of relevant work experience. An LL.M./Master's degree in a law-related field and prior experience in intellectual property law are also beneficial.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age limit for the APEDA Associate (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for this recruitment is 45 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Associate (Legal) position at APEDA?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: APEDA has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Associate (Legal) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Associate (Legal) post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Associate (Legal) position is a contract-based job.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
